title: 3EN Agent generated diagnostics script test
description: Create a PowerShell diagnostics script locally, execute it, save its output, verify the result, and keep rollback available.
backup: $Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\generated'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $Dir | Out-Null; foreach($f in @('diagnose.ps1','diagnose-output.txt')) { $p=Join-Path $Dir $f; if(Test-Path $p){ Copy-Item $p "$p.bak" -Force; Write-Host "Backed up $p" } }
script:
$Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\generated'; $ScriptPath=Join-Path $Dir 'diagnose.ps1'; $OutPath=Join-Path $Dir 'diagnose-output.txt'; $code=@'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$lines = @()
$lines += '=== 3EN GENERATED DIAGNOSTIC ==='
$lines += "Generated: $(Get-Date -Format o)"
$lines += "Computer: $env:COMPUTERNAME"
$lines += "User: $env:USERNAME"
$lines += "PowerShell: $($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)"
$lines += ''
$lines += '=== TOP 10 PROCESSES BY CPU ==='
$lines += (Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name,Id,CPU,WorkingSet | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)
$lines += '=== ACTIVE IPV4 ROUTES ==='
$lines += (Get-NetRoute -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Alive'} | Sort-Object RouteMetric | Select-Object -First 20 DestinationPrefix,NextHop,InterfaceAlias,RouteMetric | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String)
$lines
'@; Set-Content -Path $ScriptPath -Value $code -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Generated $ScriptPath"; & powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $ScriptPath | Set-Content -Path $OutPath -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host "Executed diagnostics script; output: $OutPath"
test: $Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\generated'; $ScriptPath=Join-Path $Dir 'diagnose.ps1'; $OutPath=Join-Path $Dir 'diagnose-output.txt'; if(-not (Test-Path $ScriptPath)){ throw 'Generated diagnose.ps1 not found.' }; if(-not (Test-Path $OutPath)){ throw 'Diagnostic output not found.' }; if((Get-Item $OutPath).Length -lt 150){ throw 'Diagnostic output is unexpectedly small.' }; Get-Item $ScriptPath,$OutPath | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime; Get-Content $OutPath -TotalCount 30
rollback: $Dir='C:\3EN-Agent\generated'; foreach($f in @('diagnose.ps1','diagnose-output.txt')) { $p=Join-Path $Dir $f; $bak="$p.bak"; if(Test-Path $bak){ Copy-Item $bak $p -Force; Write-Host "Restored $p" } else { Remove-Item $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host "Removed $p" } }
